readback.locator: GET /api/v1/adminrouteservice/adminroute [route with the submitted id present in the returned list]

config.note: clean control: no fault flag; the same valid route as TT-adminroute-lostwrite-001 is created and persists normally.

negative_control.replay_script: self (this IS the clean twin of TT-adminroute-lostwrite-001)

ground_truth.label: negative
ground_truth.rationale: Clean control: no fault flag, so the route is persisted normally and the read-back GET lists the submitted route id. The differential read-back oracle must NOT fire here. This is the per-case specificity check that pairs 1:1 with the positive TT-adminroute-lostwrite-001 (same input, fault off). A fire here would be a false positive on a normal successful write.

provenance.notes: Live-captured on the current kind 'mist' deploy: POST adminroute acks success and the route id appears on the read-back GET (write landed). Negative control paired 1:1 with the positive lost-write. rev-2 migration (2026-07-09): v0.1.0 injection{MIST_FAULT_LOSTWRITE_ENABLED=false} -> fault{mechanism=none}; readback_endpoint -> typed readback (api-get, present/absent); tracetest_presence_oracle=no_flag (the ts-route-service persist span IS present on the clean write, so a presence-assertion passes). trace_visibility=trace-uninstrumented (app-layer write-path spans not recorded on this deploy; the case's discriminator is the read-back, not the trace).
